Strength isn’t about being the biggest guy in the room, having the most money, driving an incredible car, or trying to convince everybody how confident you are. Real strength shows up in how you carry yourself, how you handle uncomfortable situations, and how much control you have over yourself. Strength comes down to self-respect, discipline, boundaries, emotional control, and integrity. I wasn’t always confident. I was insecure, a people pleaser, and I let other people take advantage of me. Eventually, I realized that to become a stronger, happier, more confident man, I needed to change. I worked on myself, got help when I needed it, and developed the tools to become stronger.
